group_note: Six biology items, all four-option single questions with no printed statement block, list, table or figure, so the grouping on `structure: plain` holds for every member of this packet. The demand axis was decided by one test applied to all six: does the stem ask WHICH FACT or ask WHY? q074 asks "is mainly due to" and is the only member where the live decision is whether a stated shortage accounts for a granted outcome, so it alone is `explanatory_reasoning`. The other five are `recall`: one stored definition or one stored enzyme-to-function fact names the option. Four of those five (q071, q072, q075, q078) print rival definitions of neighbouring concepts as the wrong options, and that did NOT move them to `concept_discrimination`, because the rulebook's definition of that label excludes "recalling one" and in each case the stored definition names its option without the others having to be weighed. Where the neighbours matter they are recorded on the trap axis instead, as `neighbouring_fact` - the tight and adhering junctions in q075, polymorphism in q072, rare and keystone in q071, probes and selectable markers in q078. Solution structure is `single_step` in five and `several_independent_checks` only in q073, whose negated task ("is not present") sends each of the four enzymes separately back to the stored list before the absent one can be chosen; that is the same test applied in this subject's other packets and is the one reason q073 differs. Elimination likewise appears once, in q073, where the single fact that lipase and maltase are both intestinal enzymes strikes out two options and narrows the item to the nuclease/nucleosidase pair; elsewhere the only available shortcut is already knowing the answer, so the label was withheld rather than claimed. On the trap axis the group has one strongly recurring device, an option that is the verbal reverse of the key's relation, and it carries `semantic_reversal` four times with the reversed words quoted each time: alien for endemic (q071), mineral shortage for nutrient enrichment (q074), separate for connect (q075), ligase for restriction enzyme (q078). The second recurring device is the near-identical name, `look_alike_term`, used where the two terms share a stem and differ by one element: metagenesis/metamorphosis (q072) and nucleases/nucleosidase (q073). q073 is the only member with a negated task and the only one carrying `true_statement_trap`. Where an option carries a true fact that answers something the stem did not ask, `true_but_out_of_scope` is used (q074's light penetration, which is true of a bloom but falls on submerged plants rather than on the fish). Three options were left untagged (q072 option 1, q074 option 2, q073 and q075 carry a device on every wrong option) because no option-and-route pair could be named, which rule 4 requires. No trap sits on an official answer, no source damage was found in this packet, and no `new_*` escape was needed.
